language.title: Language
language.sync_failed: Language saved on this device, but failed to sync to your account. Other devices may show the previous language.

timezone.title: Viewing Timezone
timezone.hint: Used for dashboards, charts, and any 'today' label shown to you. It's a personal preference that applies across all your workspaces.
timezone.sync_failed: Failed to save your timezone preference.

account.profile_description_hint: Shared with agents working on your behalf — role, stack, preferences, anything you'd tell a new collaborator on day one.
account.profile_description_placeholder: e.g. Backend engineer (Go + Postgres). Prefer terse PRs and tests alongside the change.
account.profile_description_too_long: Profile is too long (max {{max}} characters; currently {{count}}).
account.delete_description: Permanently delete your account, personal credentials, and workspace memberships. Shared workspace data is preserved.
account.delete_blocked: Transfer ownership or delete these workspaces first: {{workspaces}}.
account.delete_blocked_fallback: workspaces where you are the only owner

delete_account_dialog.title: Delete account
delete_account_dialog.description: This cannot be undone. Your account, personal credentials, and memberships will be permanently removed.
delete_account_dialog.ownership_notice: If you are the only owner of a workspace, assign another owner or delete that workspace first.

notifications.title: Inbox Notifications
notifications.description: Control which events generate inbox notifications. Muted event types are silently filtered — you can still see them by visiting the issue directly.

assignments.label: Assignments
assignments.description: When you are assigned or unassigned from an issue

status_changes.label: Status changes
status_changes.description: When an issue you follow changes status (e.g. todo, in progress, done)

comments.label: Comments & Mentions
comments.description: New comments on issues you follow, or when someone @mentions you

updates.label: Priority & Due date
updates.description: When priority or due date changes on issues you follow

agent_activity.label: Agent activity
agent_activity.description: When an agent task completes or fails

system.title: System Notifications
system.description: Control native OS notification banners shown when Agora is in the background.
system.label: Show system notifications
system.hint: Show a banner from your operating system for new inbox items when the app isn't focused.

browser.label: Browser notifications
browser.hint: Allow this browser to show notification banners for new inbox items.
browser.granted: This browser can show notification banners.
browser.denied: Blocked by your browser. Enable notifications for this site in your browser settings.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.description: Get the same inbox events as a Telegram DM — assignments, comments, status changes, and agent completions (including commit / PR updates).
telegram.linked_hint: Your Telegram account is linked. New inbox items are also sent as DMs.
telegram.unlinked_hint: Link Telegram to receive inbox updates as bot DMs. Open the bot, then enter the code it sends.
telegram.groups_hint: To post into a Telegram group when an agent finishes work, connect a bot under Integrations and add the group.
telegram.dialog_description: Open the bot, tap Start, then paste the 6-digit code here. This links Telegram to your current Agora account without signing you out.
telegram.toast_verify_failed: Invalid or expired code. Generate a new link and try again.
telegram.toast_conflict: That Telegram account is already linked to another Agora user

tokens.title: API Tokens
tokens.description: Personal access tokens allow the CLI and external integrations to authenticate with your account.

revoke_dialog.title: Revoke token
revoke_dialog.description: This token will be permanently revoked and can no longer be used. This cannot be undone.

created_dialog.title: Token created
created_dialog.description: Copy your personal access token now. You won't be able to see it again.

workspace.click_logo_hint: Click the logo to upload a new image
workspace.description_placeholder: What does this workspace focus on?
workspace.context_placeholder: Background information and context for AI agents working in this workspace
workspace.prefix_confirm_description: All issues will be renumbered from {{oldPrefix}}-N to {{newPrefix}}-N. External references — pull request titles, branch names, links in docs and chat — that use {{oldPrefix}}-N will stop resolving.
workspace.manage_hint: Only admins and owners can update workspace settings.
workspace.leave_sole_owner: You're the only owner. Promote another member to owner first, or delete the workspace.
workspace.leave_sole_member: You're the only member. Delete the workspace to leave.
workspace.leave_confirm_description: Leave {{name}}? You will lose access until re-invited.
workspace.delete_description: Permanently delete this workspace and its data.

delete_workspace_dialog.title: Delete workspace
delete_workspace_dialog.description: This cannot be undone. All issues, agents, and data will be permanently removed.

labs.section_placeholder_description: Experimental settings will land here as they ship. Today this tab is intentionally empty.
labs.qa_dev_runtimes_description: When the developer's own daemon is online and declares a local app for the issue's project (agora daemon apps set <project> <url>), the QA task executes on THAT machine and tests the locally running app. Off = QA always runs on shared runtimes.
labs.qa_dev_runtimes_strict_label: Strict: wait for the developer's daemon instead of falling back when it is offline
labs.dev_machines_empty: No developer machine has declared a local app yet. On the dev's machine: agora daemon apps set <project> <url>, then restart the daemon.

github.page_description: Connect a GitHub App, control how Pull Requests show up inside Agora, and decide what your agents leave behind in commit history.
github.master_description_on: When off, every GitHub UI affordance is hidden and no new side-effects are written. Existing data is kept on the backend. Not a development team? Just turn it off here.
github.master_description_off: GitHub features are turned off. The PR sidebar, co-author trailer, and auto-link are paused. Data on the backend is not deleted.
github.connection_description_prefix: Link issues to pull requests automatically. When a PR with
github.connection_description_suffix: in its branch, title, or body is merged, the corresponding issue moves to
github.connect_disabled_tooltip: GitHub App is not configured on this server
github.disconnect_confirm_description: Agora will stop receiving webhooks for this installation. Existing PR mirrors and links are kept; reconnect any time to resume updates.
github.not_configured: GitHub integration is not configured for this deployment. Operators must set
github.read_only_hint: Read-only view. Only workspace admins and owners can connect or disconnect GitHub.
github.contact_admin_to_connect: GitHub is not connected for this workspace. Ask an admin or owner to set up the GitHub App.
github.toast_not_configured: GitHub integration is not configured for this deployment
github.feature_pr_sidebar_description: Show linked pull requests inside the issue detail sidebar.
github.feature_auto_link_description: Match PR titles, bodies, and branch names against issue identifiers and create the link automatically.
github.repositories_shortcut_label: Repository URLs live in the Repositories tab

lark.page_description: Connect each Agora Agent to a Lark (飞书) PersonalAgent Bot. Members can DM the Bot, @ it in groups, and type /issue to spin up a new Agora issue.
lark.not_enabled_description_suffix: on the server to enable Lark Bot installations.
lark.not_enabled_self_host_hint: Self-hosters: see the project README for details.
lark.preview_description: The at-rest key is set, but the Lark HTTP client is not wired in this build. The install entry point will appear here once the transport is enabled in a follow-up release.
lark.empty_description_prefix: Open an Agent in this workspace and click
lark.empty_description_suffix: to install a Bot for it.
lark.disconnect_confirm_description: The Bot will stop receiving Lark messages and the WebSocket connection will be torn down. The installation row is kept for audit; you can re-install later from the same Agent.
lark.agent_bot_manage_tooltip: Open this Bot's app page in Lark — manage scopes, edit display name, request additional permissions.
lark.agent_bot_manage_tooltip_feishu: Open this Bot's app page in Feishu — manage scopes, edit display name, request additional permissions.
lark.agent_bot_manage_tooltip_lark: Open this Bot's app page in Lark — manage scopes, edit display name, request additional permissions.
lark.agent_bot_disconnect_tooltip: Unbind this Lark Bot from the Agent. The Bot will stop receiving Lark messages.
lark.install_dialog_description: Open Lark on your phone and scan the code below to create a PersonalAgent Bot.
lark.install_dialog_description_for_agent: Open Lark on your phone and scan the code below to create a Bot for {{agent}}.
lark.install_dialog_description_feishu: Open Feishu on your phone and scan the code below to create a PersonalAgent Bot.
lark.install_dialog_description_lark: Open Lark on your phone and scan the code below to create a PersonalAgent Bot.
lark.install_dialog_description_for_agent_fei: Open Feishu on your phone and scan the code below to create a Bot for {{agent}}.
lark.install_dialog_description_for_agent_lar: Open Lark on your phone and scan the code below to create a Bot for {{agent}}.
lark.install_scan_hint: Lark → Scan → authorize the new PersonalAgent.
lark.install_open_link_fallback: Or tap here to open in Lark
lark.install_success: Install complete — your Bot is online.
lark.install_scan_hint_feishu: Feishu → Scan → authorize the new PersonalAgent.
lark.install_scan_hint_lark: Lark → Scan → authorize the new PersonalAgent.
lark.install_open_link_fallback_feishu: Or tap here to open in Feishu
lark.install_open_link_fallback_lark: Or tap here to open in Lark
lark.install_poll_retry: Network blip while checking install status — retrying.
lark.install_error_expired: QR expired before authorization. Scan again.
lark.install_error_protocol: Lark refused the install — try again.
lark.install_error_bot_info: Authorized, but Agora couldn't fetch the Bot's identity. Try again.
lark.install_error_conflict: Could not save the installation. Another bot may already be bound to this agent.
lark.install_error_installer_bind: Installed the bot, but could not bind your Lark identity. Try again or contact support.
lark.install_error_session_lost: Install session expired or was lost. Scan again to start over.
lark.install_error_forbidden: You no longer have permission to install Lark Bots in this workspace. Ask a workspace admin to continue.

repositories.description: Git repositories associated with this workspace. Agents use these to clone and work on code.
repositories.manage_hint: Only admins and owners can manage repositories.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: The desktop app checks for new versions automatically once an hour and shortly after launch, downloading them in the background. You'll be prompted to restart once an update is ready.
updates.check_section_description: Trigger a check now instead of waiting for the next automatic poll. Available updates download in the background and show a restart prompt when ready.
updates.downloading: v{{version}} is downloading in the background — you'll be notified when it's ready to install.

members.revoke_invitation_description: Revoke the invitation to {{email}}? They will no longer be able to join this workspace.
members.remove_member_description: Remove {{name}} from {{workspace}}? They will lose access to this workspace.
members.cannot_demote_last_owner_title: Promote another member to owner first — a workspace must keep at least one owner.

integrations.intro: Connect the tools your team and agents already use.

mcp.name: MCP servers
mcp.description: Connect any tool your agents can use — GitHub, Linear, Postgres, or any MCP server.
mcp.body: Import a shared Claude/Cursor-compatible mcp.json for the workspace, then add or override connections on selected agents.

release.name: Release
release.description: Notify Slack, cut GitHub or GitLab releases, or ping Sentry when a sprint ships.

figma.name: Figma
figma.description: Let agents read Figma designs referenced in issues.

bitrix.name: Bitrix24
bitrix.description: Import Bitrix24 workgroups and tasks, and mirror status back.

zoho.name: Zoho
zoho.description: Connect Zoho CRM, Desk, Projects, and Sprints to this workspace.

lark.name: Lark
lark.description: Connect each agent to a Lark bot your team can DM and mention.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.description: Connect per-agent bots and groups for chat and work updates. Personal inbox DMs are linked under Notifications.

figma.description: One workspace token that lets agents read Figma designs referenced by issues. When an issue links a Figma file, the agent's MCP config is filled automatically at claim time — no per-agent setup.
figma.expires_hint: Figma PATs expire after at most 90 days — set this so you get a renewal warning.
figma.probe_file_hint: A file key the token can read; used once to detect seat-limited tokens.
figma.not_configured: No Figma token configured. Agents cannot read linked designs.
figma.seat_warning: This token looks seat-limited (~6 requests/month). Use a token from a Dev or Full seat.
figma.error_invalid_token: Figma rejected this token. Check it and try again.

release_integrations.description: Fan release events out to your own tools — Slack, GitHub or GitLab Releases, Sentry, Bitrix, or a signed webhook. Deploy and ship events (with the sprint changelog) are delivered to whatever you configure.
release_integrations.not_configured: No release integrations yet. Add a connector to get notified — or cut a release — when a deploy is recorded or a sprint ships.
release_integrations.secret_hint: If set, each delivery carries an X-Agora-Signature HMAC so your receiver can verify it. Write-only — never shown again.
release_integrations.token_hint: Write-only — sealed on save and never shown again.
release_integrations.bitrix_note: Uses the workspace's Bitrix connection. When a sprint ships, each shipped issue linked to a Bitrix task gets a comment.
release_integrations.remove_confirm_body: “{{name}}” will stop receiving release events. This can't be undone.

workspace_design.title: Shared design system
workspace_design.description: The workspace-level design system every project inherits as its base — so all your apps converge on one system, each project overriding only its specifics. Injected into every designer and implementation run.

connection.title: Workspace connection
connection.description: One Zoho OAuth client and refresh token for the whole workspace — powers CRM module discovery and sync. Secrets are sealed on the server and never shown again.
connection.not_configured: No Zoho connection configured. Personal bindings and CRM module sync are unavailable until one is saved.
connection.disconnect_confirm_description: CRM module sync stops and every member's personal Zoho binding stops working until a new connection is saved.
connection.error_invalid_credentials: Zoho rejected these credentials. Check the client ID, client secret and refresh token.
connection.error_sealing_unavailable: This server can't store Zoho secrets (AGORA_ZOHO_SECRET_KEY is unset). Ask your server administrator to configure it.

binding.title: Your Zoho account
binding.description: Connect your own Zoho account so agents acting for you call Zoho as you.
binding.requires_connection: A workspace owner or admin must configure the Zoho connection before you can connect your account.
binding.grant_help: Generate a self-client grant code in the Zoho API console with the scopes shown below, then paste it here within a few minutes — codes are single-use and expire quickly.
binding.error_grant_invalid: Zoho rejected the grant code — codes are single-use and expire within minutes. Generate a fresh one and try again.

import.title: Zoho import
import.description: Import work from the Zoho suite into Agora. Each Zoho Projects project (and Zoho Sprints project) becomes an Agora project; its tasks and items become issues.

modules.title: CRM module sync
modules.description: Choose which Zoho CRM modules sync into Agora as issues — per module, with direction and field/status maps.
modules.requires_connection: Configure the workspace Zoho connection to discover CRM modules.
modules.admin_only: Only workspace owners and admins can manage CRM module sync.
modules.load_error: Couldn't load CRM modules. Check the workspace connection, then refresh.
modules.empty: No API-supported CRM modules found in this Zoho org.
modules.select_hint: Select a module to configure its sync.
modules.field_map_hint: Agora field → Zoho field API name. Allowed Agora fields: title, description, priority, due_date, status.
modules.status_map_hint: "in" maps Zoho statuses to Agora statuses; "out" maps Agora statuses back to Zoho.
modules.invalid_json: Must be a valid JSON object
modules.delete_confirm_description: {{module}} stops syncing. Issues already created in Agora are kept.

telegram.page_description: Give an agent its own Telegram bot so it can speak in a group under its own name, take instructions, and post when work finishes. For personal inbox DMs (assign, comment, done), link Telegram under Settings → Notifications.
telegram.not_configured_description: This deployment has no encryption key for bot tokens, so an installation cannot be completed. Ask an operator to set AGORA_TELEGRAM_SECRET_KEY.
telegram.empty_description: Create a bot in Telegram's @BotFather, then connect it to an agent here.
telegram.install_description: Each agent gets one bot. Create it in @BotFather, then paste its token — the token is encrypted on the server and never shown again.
telegram.install_no_agents: Every agent already has a bot.
telegram.install_token_hint: From @BotFather. Turn off the bot's privacy mode if it should read every group message, not only replies and mentions.
telegram.disconnect_description: The agent stops receiving and sending messages in Telegram. Its stored token is deleted; reconnecting needs the token again.
telegram.bind_description: Scan to add the bot to a group. The code carries a single-use token — being invited to a group is not by itself permission to act in it.
telegram.bind_expiry_hint: Valid for 10 minutes and usable once.
telegram.bind_failed: Could not generate a code. Try again.
telegram.access_description: Reporting is unaffected: a closed bot still posts its reports, it just takes no orders.
telegram.policy_hint: Closed refuses everyone. Allowlist admits only the users below. Open admits anyone in an allowed group.
telegram.access_chats_hint: Numeric chat ids, one per line. Group ids are negative. Adding a group by QR fills this in for you.
telegram.access_users_hint: Numeric Telegram user ids, one per line. Only used by the allowlist policy.
